name: Pilot_Test_1
description: Sample built by iFlow Pilot: HTTPS sender -> Content Modifier -> Groovy -> HTTP receiver

steps.name: Add Length Header
steps.code:
import com.sap.gateway.ip.core.customdev.util.Message

def Message processData(Message message) {
    def body = message.getBody(String) ?: ''
    message.setHeader('X-Pilot-Length', body.length().toString())
    message.setProperty('PilotProcessed', 'true')
    return message
}
